title: Document Service State File
description: BMAD-adapted state persistence schema for /document-service skill. Tracks workflow progress, outputs generated, and resumability.

last_updated.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of last step completion

completed.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when workflow completed (only set in step-08)

mode.description: Execution mode: initial_scan (all steps 1-8), full_rescan (all steps, overwrite docs), deep_dive (steps 1-6 only, skip user confirmations)

scan_level.description: Scanning granularity: quick (pattern matching, no file reading), deep (critical dirs only), exhaustive (all files)

project_root.description: Absolute path to the project being scanned (e.g., /Users/.../orders-service)

current_step.description: Current step pointer for resumability. Set to 'complete' when all steps done.

next_step.description: Next step to execute. Set to null when workflow complete.

completed_steps.description: Array of completed steps with metadata for resumability

summary.description: Brief summary of what the step did

outputs_generated.description: Complete list of all documentation files generated across all steps

drift_check_status.description: Result of CLAUDE.md drift check (step-07). PASSED if no mismatches, FAILED if drift detected.

drift_items_found.description: Number of drift items found (mismatches between scan and CLAUDE.md)

drift_report_generated.description: Path to drift report if generated (.intellisense-drift-report.md at repo root), null if no drift found

scan_results.description: Cached scan results from steps 1-2 for resumability. Purged after file generation.

framework_type.description: Framework: GORM, Pop, Laravel, Angular, etc.

directory_tree.description: Directory structure with file counts per directory

file_counts.description: Total counts: models, services, handlers, migrations, tests, etc.

billing_system_webhooks.description: Detected the external billing system webhook handlers (PHP only)

context_data.description: User-confirmed service metadata from step-04. Purged after project-context.md written.

categories_confirmed.description: List of categories user confirmed in step-04

api_data.description: Endpoint discoveries from step-05. Purged after api-contracts.md written.

endpoints_documented.description: Total number of endpoints found and documented

authentication_methods.description: List of unique auth types found (Bearer, API key, Service-to-service, None)

resume_instructions.description: Human-readable instructions for resuming or refreshing the workflow
resume_instructions.example:
To resume from next step: /document-service --resume
To refresh docs without re-scanning: /document-service --update-only
